answer: Identity is not free: every new agent key needs countersigning by two established operators, and their own vault stake stays locked behind it for a full epoch. If a cluster of fresh keys later moves as one body, voting in the same echo pattern within the same minute on the same target, those sponsor stakes burn. A Sybil farm can no longer clone itself cheaply; it must recruit independent, solvent backers for each identity, so one fake voice costs two real balances placed at risk. Clones drop out at the door like rain into a karst sink.
